helpText.defaultSorting:
Why can't I see both "Top Results" and "Recommendation"?
To avoid redundancy, only one of the two relevance-based sorting options is shown to customers. The visible one depends on default settings, service activation, and priority. "Recommendation" will replace "Top Results" when it has a higher or equal priority. 
For more details, please read our official Nosto Shopware sorting documentation.
